```{=html}
<script>
// ============================================================
// ADD NEW PEARLS HERE — newest at the top
// ============================================================
const PEARLS = [
  { date: "2026-08-01", text: "Ranna aku S sekali pengen ngentot." },
  { date: "2026-08-01", text: "Janganlah kita terlalu gegabah. Selalu ada ruang untuk berkembang." },
];
// ============================================================

const HASH = "074f2d98a216b0b52af5665889d5aefd4e5025cdb0a73b0b855c6cff86e61d30";
const KEY = "pearls_v3";

async function sha256(msg) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}

async function unlock() {
  const btn = document.getElementById("btn");
  const input = document.getElementById("pwd");
  const err = document.getElementById("err");

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = "Checking...";
  err.style.display = "none";

  const hash = await sha256(input.value.trim());

  if (hash === HASH) {
    sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, "1");
    document.getElementById("gate").style.opacity = "0";
    setTimeout(show, 300);
  } else {
    input.classList.add("shake");
    input.value = "";
    err.style.display = "block";
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = "Enter";
    setTimeout(() => input.classList.remove("shake"), 500);
  }
}

function show() {
  document.getElementById("gate").style.display = "none";
  const list = PEARLS.map(p =>
    `<div class="pearl"><span class="pearl-date">${p.date}</span><p class="pearl-text">${p.text}</p></div>`
  ).join("");
  document.getElementById("pearls").innerHTML =
    `<h1 style="font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:0.25rem;">Pearls of Wisdom</h1>
     <p style="color:#6e6e73;font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:2rem;">Daily rantings. Handle with care.</p>
     <div class="pearl-list">${list}</div>`;
  document.getElementById("pearls").style.display = "block";
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  if (sessionStorage.getItem(KEY) === "1") show();
  document.getElementById("pwd").focus();
});
</script>

<style>
#gate {
  max-width: 340px;
  margin: 100px auto 0;
  text-align: center;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}
#gate h2 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  color: #1a1a1a;
}
#gate .subtitle {
  color: #6e6e73;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}
#pwd {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
  border: 1.5px solid #ebebeb;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  outline: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  text-align: center;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
  background: #fafafa;
}
#pwd:focus { border-color: #2d6a4f; background: #fff; }
#btn {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.65rem;
  background: #2d6a4f;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
}
#btn:hover { background: #245a40; }
#btn:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }
#err {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  background: #fef2f2;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: #b91c1c;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
@keyframes shake {
  0%,100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  20%,60% { transform: translateX(-6px); }
  40%,80% { transform: translateX(6px); }
}
.shake { animation: shake 0.4s ease; border-color: #b91c1c !important; }

#pearls { display:none; max-width:680px; margin:0 auto; }
.pearl-list { border-top: 1px solid #ebebeb; }
.pearl { display:grid; grid-template-columns:110px 1fr; gap:1rem; padding:1.1rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid #ebebeb; align-items:start; }
.pearl-date { color:#6e6e73; font-size:0.82rem; padding-top:0.15rem; white-space:nowrap; }
.pearl-text { margin:0; font-size:0.97rem; line-height:1.65; color:#1a1a1a; }
@media (max-width:480px) { .pearl { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:0.25rem; } }
</style>

<div id="gate">
  <h2>Pearls of Wisdom</h2>
  <p class="subtitle">Write the magic word.</p>
  <input id="pwd" type="text" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') unlock()" autocomplete="off" />
  <button id="btn" onclick="unlock()">Enter</button>
  <div id="err">Wrong word. Try again.</div>
</div>

<div id="pearls"></div>
```
